title: Bellman Residual Bracketing: Resolving the Sample Complexity of Discounted and Average-Reward RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.19566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the sample complexity of the empirical planning or plug-in approach for reinforcement learning (RL) with a generative model. We show the discounted plug-in approach finds an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with $O(SA (1-\gamma)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/\delta))$ samples, where $S, A, \gamma, \delta$ are the state and action sizes, discount factor, and failure probability, respectively. In the average-reward setting, we show that discounted plug-in and direct (undiscounted) plug-in achieve $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ and $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ complexities, respectively, where $H$ upper-bounds the optimal bias span and $D$ is the diameter. Combining with our lower bounds for nonadaptive generative models, these results resolve the minimax sample complexity of discounted RL and average-reward RL --- in both the span- and diameter-based classes --- up to constant factors. translated_title: 贝尔曼残差括号法：解决折扣型与平均奖励强化学习的样本复杂度问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了基于生成模型的强化学习（RL）中经验规划或插件（plug-in）方法的样本复杂度。我们证明折扣型插件方法能够以 $O(SA (1-\gamma)^{-3} \varepsilon^{-2} \log(SA/\delta))$ 的样本量找到 $\varepsilon$-最优策略，其中 $S$、$A$、$\gamma$、$\delta$ 分别表示状态数、动作数、折扣因子和失败概率。在平均奖励设定下，我们证明折扣型插件和直接（无折扣）插件方法分别达到 $O(SAH\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ 和 $O(SAD\varepsilon^{-2}\log(SA/\delta))$ 的复杂度，其中 $H$ 是最优偏差跨度的上界，$D$ 是直径。结合我们针对非自适应生成模型给出的下界，这些结果在常数因子范围内解决了折扣型RL和平均奖励RL的极小极大（minimax）样本复杂度问题——无论是基于跨度的类别还是基于直径的类别。我们的主要技术贡献……
tldr: 本文提出贝尔曼残差括号技术，建立了折扣型与平均奖励强化学习中插件方法的紧致样本复杂度上界，并结合下界在常数因子内解决了两类问题的极小极大样本复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Bellman residual bracketing to establish tight sample complexity upper bounds for plug-in approaches in discounted and average-reward RL, resolving the minimax sample complexity of both settings up to constant factors.
